first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: The background crowd of spectators behind the roadside barriers or walls along the track, primarily the dense crowd on the left; spectators on different sections of the route are not treated as the same group of individuals.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The rider in the first-person foreground, with black long sleeves, white gloves, and hands operating Vehicle A's handlebars visible.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The mountain bicycle operated by Person B, with a black flat handlebar, black front tire, red front components, and some silver controls visible.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The narrow gray hard-surfaced road that runs basically straight downhill between residences, with a lighter paved edge strip along its right edge.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: Gray tubular-frame mesh barrier panels arranged along the road, separating the spectators on the left; in the later section, some panels on the right are tilted and overlap.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The yellow-gray rough stone wall, light-colored wall base, and light yellow-gray plastered wall surface extending along the road on the right.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The group of residential buildings on both sides of the road and in the distance, with red, orange, light blue, light yellow, and pink exterior walls.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: Small patches of blue sky visible through gaps between distant buildings and along the upper edge of the image.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: Green foliage and tree crowns visible atop the wall on the right and behind the residences.

entities.name: strip of bare soil beside the road
entities.identification: The yellow-brown strip of soil between the hard road edge and the base of the wall on the right, with gravel and dried plant debris in places.

entities.name: patterned ramp surface with a black background
entities.identification: The black patterned surface below and in front of Vehicle A at the beginning, showing white-and-red lettering and portions of yellow-and-red graphics and connecting to the gray road.
